meta.label: Population, by NUTS 3 region (2023)
meta.methodNote: Total resident population per NUTS 3 region (province-equivalent), Eurostat's own demo_r_pjanaggr3 dataset, 2023 — the newest year whose only gap is the UK (absent since 2020; its last real value predates this file's vintage), not a further reporting-lag gap on top of that. Albania is present for every one of its 12 NUTS 3 units. Boundaries: github.com/eurostat/Nuts2json, 2021 typology.
meta.coverageNote: The UK has no NUTS 3 population figure for 2023 or any year since 2019 in Eurostat's own data — not a join failure on this site's part. Every other EU/EFTA/candidate country's NUTS 3 units with a boundary in this map have a value, Albania included.
